notes: The Recipe Box and the Cooking editor now feel like one app. Opening a recipe in the Recipe Box shows an Edit button that jumps straight into that recipe's edit form; the Cooking page header leads back to the Recipe Box. Every recipe now remembers who added it and shows a small 'added by' byline. And each guest account gets its own button on the hub's main page - for example 'Grandma's Recipes' - opening the Recipe Box filtered to just the recipes she has added, so her shelf of the family cookbook is one tap away.
